name: hryvinskyi/magento2-encryption-key-rotator
description: Standalone tool that rotates a Magento 2 encryption key, re-encrypts stored values and can roll the rotation back.

test:integration: docker compose run --rm -e DB_SERVICE=mariadb php81 vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration
docker compose run --rm -e DB_SERVICE=mysql php81 vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration
docker compose run --rm -e DB_SERVICE=mariadb php83 vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration
docker compose run --rm -e DB_SERVICE=mysql php83 vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration
build:smoke: docker compose run --rm -e DB_SERVICE=mariadb php81 php build/smoke.php
docker compose run --rm -e DB_SERVICE=mysql php83 php build/smoke.php

scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 10 for PHP 8.1.
scripts-descriptions.deptrac: Layer boundaries: zero violations, no baseline.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Unit tests and the contract tests of the in-memory doubles, on the host PHP.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration tests on PHP 8.1 and 8.3 against MariaDB 10.6 and MySQL 8.0.
scripts-descriptions.test:compat: Compatibility tests against a real Magento root (MAGENTO_ROOT required, MAGENTO_PHP optional).
scripts-descriptions.build: Compile the container, pack the phar and start it on PHP 8.1 and 8.3.
scripts-descriptions.build:phar: Compile the container and pack build/key-rotator.phar.
scripts-descriptions.build:smoke: Run the packed phar on PHP 8.1 and 8.3: about, and scan --format=json against a seeded store.
